capture: recorded-attempts.jsonl and recorded-admissions.jsonl are copied by script from the events.jsonl of the five generic pilot runs (L-142) whose verifier plan admission exhausted the 3-attempt planner budget. run_dir is relative to the bench scratch root; event_file is relative to run_dir; event_sha256 is the SHA-256 of that events.jsonl; source_code is the commit the run binary was built from. recorded-attempts.jsonl keeps, per planner attempt, the event line, class (quality from planner_quality_retry, policy from planner_error with planner_stage verify_policy, admission from recovery_verifier_plan_admission) and reason, then the ultra_phase_failed and run_stop lines; it matches the S-143a section 3 table. recorded-admissions.jsonl keeps the final (attempt 3, exhausted) recovery_verifier_plan_admission event's reason, original_scope, model_proposal and host_augmented_proposal unchanged. Provider and model fields are not copied.
derived_fixture: synthetic-cases.json is synthetic: the verifier script of each recorded mixed owner and the step ids the accepted owner split admits (tests/verifier_separation_guidance.rs), and the Replay cases in src/planner/recovery_step_plan_binding/issue466_tests/formation.rs.
